messages:
tess: Quick poll — what's one small everyday item you consistently lose or misplace? socks, earbuds, keys, pens, chargers? curious to catalog human inefficiency :mag:
kevin: Chargers. I buy a new one every 3 months. :phone:
anya: Socks in the laundry vortex. no explanation. :socks:
mike: Pens. Somehow they only exist under random piles of paper. Starting to suspect a pen mafia.
sophia: TV remote. It vanishes then shows up in the fridge once a month. :joy:
akshay: Headphones — I blame my bag. Also: @mike can confirm the pen situation.
ops-bot: Reminder: lost-and-found box in kitchen labeled 'misc'. Please drop items there. :card_file_box:
tess: Ooh, good call — should we start a 'universal charger drawer' in the kitchen? bring-your-own cable but leave it available.
anya: Yes to the charger drawer. I'll make a sticky note.
mike: I'll donate a dozen pens. small contribution, big goodwill.
sophia: Whoever put the remote in the fridge, this is your moment to fess up. :eyes:
kevin: Happy to contribute chargers if someone creates the drawer. I'll leave one by the sink tomorrow.
tess: Awesome — thanks all. Data point: chargers and socks are the top two. I'll put a note on the kitchen board tomorrow. :memo:
